issue.title: ### Summary
issue.body: ### Summary As per the announcement, [learning lab was deprecated](https://github.blog/changelog/2022-09-01-deprecating-learning-lab/). However, the learning lab URL (https://lab.github.com/) is still available but leads to a 404 error page. You might want to redirect this to https://skills.github.com/. ### How to reproduce 1. Go to https://lab.github.com/. 2. See 404 error. _Originally posted by @dipikabh in https://github.com/skills/introduction-to-github/issues/682_
